paragraphs.text: Hilario Zepeda Montaño participated in Shipment MZN-10-01 on 2010-03-14. Bruma del Cobre was linked to Shipment MZN-10-01 on 2010-03-14. Shipment MZN-10-01 occurred at Manzanillo on 2010-03-14. A trucking dispatcher with regular access to loads leaving the Manzanillo terminal reported that Zepeda, the man the crews call El Hormiga, arranged the first northbound load of the new network on the same day its founders met. The load consisted of 900 kg of methamphetamine precursor concealed in a refrigerated container that had cleared the yard without inspection. The dispatcher stated that the destination given to the driver was a warehouse on the outskirts of Phoenix.

Tráiler Cerro Pardo Siete was involved in Shipment MZN-10-01 on 2010-03-14. Hilario Zepeda Montaño used DEMO-ACCT-00118 on 2010-03-14. Shipment MZN-10-01 transited Manzanillo port plaza on 2010-03-14. The dispatcher identified the tractor-trailer by its fleet name and stated that the same unit had been used for legitimate produce runs in the preceding months. The account identifier was the one the dispatcher was told to reference when confirming that the driver had been paid. The dispatcher did not observe the load being packed and relied on a yard clerk for the description of the contents.

Bruma del Cobre controlled Manzanillo port plaza from 2010-03-14 until 2014-08-02. Rogelio Anzures Tapia led Bruma del Cobre from 2010-03-14 until 2014-08-02. Hilario Zepeda Montaño was a member of Bruma del Cobre from 2010-03-14 until 2012-07-09. The dispatcher described Anzures as the person who approved the route and Zepeda as the person who executed it. The reporting office notes that the dispatcher has reported accurately on terminal activity in the past but has limited visibility into the network's leadership. The weight reported here is the dispatcher's estimate from the manifest and was not independently verified.
